caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate, shell-shaped porcelain dish with a white base color. The dish features multiple sections, including a central rounded area surrounded by scalloped edges and an additional, smaller shell-shaped compartment attached to the upper left. The surface of the dish is embellished with small floral patterns in pastel pink, yellow, and green hues that are distributed across the entire visible surface. The edges are outlined with fine gold or tan lines, emphasizing the contours and ridges of the shell form. The drawing is centered within a thin black rectangular border on a beige background. The lower right corner of the bordered area contains a small handwritten signature: "J. H. Holloway."
title: Candle Holder
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
